name: bhissm
description: Bharat Health Initiative for SupplyChain Sourcing and Management

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); try { fs.copyFileSync('backend/prisma/bhissm.db', 'dist/bhissm.db'); } catch(e){ console.warn('DB copy warning:', e.message); }"
scripts.setup:backend: npm install --prefix backend && npm run db:push --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
